source_title: An InventHelp 123Invent Client Develops Convenient Women's Personal-Storage Idea (CTK-532)
source_excerpt:
PITTSBURGH , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- "I wanted to create a more convenient and discreet way for women to keep money and other small valuables close at hand," said an inventor from Lansford, Pennsylvania. "My idea would provide added security and peace of mind while allowing the wearer to travel more lightly."
InventHelp Invention Spotlight: POCKET BRA Could Help Women Securely Carry Small Personal Items
Provides discreet storage for money and other small valuables
Offers convenient access to essential personal items
Helps reduce the risk of loose belongings becoming lost InventHelp Client's Invention for Women
Women may need a secure and convenient way to carry money, identification and other small personal belongings when a purse or wallet would be unnecessary or inconvenient. The POCKET BRA would address this concern by offering a discreet personal-storage option and could appeal to women and girls seeking convenience, security and greater freedom while traveling, attending events or completing everyday activities.

About InventHelp: Empowering Inventors with Tools, Guidance, and Potential Exposure
